1	"""session_stop (DESIGN_PANEL decision-making-6, both judges' fixes): does the causal session ledger carry information about the
2	next SETUP's L1 net beyond the hour-of-day effect, and if so does a daily stop rule (k stops / loss L) add kept-vs-skipped
3	expectancy beyond the costs it saves?
4	
5	    python session_stop.py               # both timeframes (minute = primary, 5minute = underpowered), label L1, IS only
6	    python session_stop.py --selftest    # pure-function checks only (no ledger row is written)
7	
8	REPAIR NOTE (added 2026-09-29 AFTER the run; this docstring is otherwise the pre-registered text; the run's ledger rows carry
9	script_sha 6645343d4dfba103 = this file before the note). The adversarial refuters showed that null N1 below is mis-specified:
10	it permutes outcomes over FIXED positions, but the positions are generated by the outcomes (a Foundation trade runs until exit
11	and the next SETUP follows it; winners hold ~6x longer than losers), so a memoryless process reproduces the rejection and its
12	"mean-reverting" direction. The statement "a rejection is session memory beyond the hour effect" is WITHDRAWN. The
13	hindsight-free re-test (N3 / N4), the memoryless demonstration and the re-judged branch B are in session_stop_repair.py;
14	FINDINGS.md section R has the repaired result. Nothing below was edited; do not re-use N1 as an entry condition.
15	
16	Definitions (fixed before any number was looked at; also written to preregistration.json before the first statistic):
17	  unit         a harness row: a Foundation SETUP taken under the L1 (15:25) book, harness.load(tf, "L1"); IS rows only
18	  ledger       the session's Foundation trades closed by the SETUP bar k (as built: entry < k, exit <= k; verified identical on the
19	               truncated build): today_net_asof (sum of their L1 net, INR), today_n_stops_asof (their stop_loss exits). On this book
20	               the ledger equals the cumulative outcomes of the session's earlier units (asserted in code), so a permuted sequence's
21	               ledger is recomputed exactly as the cumulative sum / count of the permuted outcomes before each position
22	  hour_bin     the build's clock bins: <09:25, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, >=15:20
23	  7 tests      (a) Spearman rho(today_net_asof, own L1 net); (b) mean L1 net where today_n_stops_asof >= k minus mean where < k,
24	               k = 1, 2, 3; (c) mean L1 net where today_net_asof <= L minus mean where > L, L = -2000, -4000, -6000 INR
25	  null N1      (primary, pre-registered entry condition; Judge 1) outcomes (net, stop flag) permuted among the units of the same
26	               session x hour_bin cell, positions fixed, the ledger recomputed from the permuted sequence: the hour profile of
27	               outcomes is preserved exactly, so a rejection is session memory beyond the hour effect
28	  null N2      (secondary, the design's plain null) the same with cells = sessions
29	  draws / p    2,000 draws per null, seeded numpy default_rng(int(sha1("fz|session_stop|<tf>|<label>|<null>"), 16) % 2**32);
30	               the permutation distribution is NOT centred at zero (under N1 the ledger still grows with the clock, so a later
31	               position has both more stops and the later hours' expectancy; under both nulls sampling without replacement inside a
32	               session makes "k stops already" slightly favour a non-stop next), so the two-sided p is the doubled tail against the
33	               permutation distribution: p = min(1, 2 min(p_lo, p_hi)), p_lo = (1 + #{stat* <= stat}) / (1 + draws), p_hi the same
34	               for >=; the naive form (1 + #{|stat*| >= |stat|}) / (1 + draws) is reported as p_abs for reference only; the excess =
35	               stat - mean(stat*) is the part of the statistic beyond the hour effect. Holm over the 7 tests per null per timeframe.
36	               (This p definition replaced the naive form after a 50-draw timing probe on 1 min showed the N1 distribution off
37	               centre; nothing else changed and no full run had been made.)
38	  decision     branch B (the grid) runs on a timeframe iff min Holm-adjusted p under N1 on L1 < 0.05; otherwise the study ends
39	               there for that timeframe: "no session memory beyond the hour effect", no key, no ledger row
40	  robustness   the same 7 tests on L0 (harness.load(tf, "L0")), reported, never the decision
41	  branch B     fixed 16-cell grid k in {1,2,3,4} x L in {-2000,-4000,-6000,none}: a unit is skipped once the session's ledger at its
42	               bar has >= k stops or net <= L (absorbing for the rest of the session; before the first trigger the strategy's own
43	               ledger equals Foundation's, so the replay is exact); one more axis rearm_after_win: when stopped, a skipped SETUP whose
44	               Foundation paper trade closes with net > 0 re-arms the rule at the next SETUP with the counters reset (32 cells);
45	               every cell = ledger row family session_stop/grid; nested choice inside the 12 purged training folds (max diff among
46	               cells with kept_share >= 0.20; tie -> larger kept share), the OOF mask = one row session_stop/nested; the 66 CPCV
47	               splits -> 11 paths (session_stop/nested/cpcv); the cell chosen on all IS = the candidate (its grid row); PBO / SPA /
48	               effective trials over the grid family; DSR with n_trials = cells; block-bootstrap CI; harness.go_no_go; the combined
49	               form (candidate AND fz_traded) = one row session_stop/combined per timeframe
50	  judgement    kept-vs-skipped mean net (INR per trade), the session-matched control percentile (a within-session gate: the standard
51	               control applies directly), the permutation p, loser recall / precision, |net|-weighted winner recall; never net alone
52	"""
53	import os, sys, json, time, argparse, hashlib, datetime as D
54	sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
55	HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
56	OUT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", ".."))
57	sys.path.insert(0, OUT)
58	import numpy as np, pandas as pd
59	from scipy import stats as sst
60	import harness as H
61	
62	STUDY = "session_stop"
63	HOUR_ORDER = ["<09:25", "09", "10", "11", "12", "13", "14", "15", ">=15:20"]
64	K_GRID, L_GRID = [1, 2, 3, 4], [-2000.0, -4000.0, -6000.0, None]
65	REARM_AXIS = [False, True]
66	NULL_DRAWS, ALPHA = 2000, 0.05
67	TESTS = ["spearman_today_net", "stops>=1", "stops>=2", "stops>=3", "net<=-2000", "net<=-4000", "net<=-6000"]
68	K_TESTS, L_TESTS = [1, 2, 3], [-2000.0, -4000.0, -6000.0]
69	KEPT_SHARE_FLOOR = 0.20
70	T0 = time.time()
71	LOG = open(os.path.join(HERE, "session_stop.log"), "a", encoding="utf-8")
72	
73	
74	def log(*a):
75	    s = " ".join(str(x) for x in a)
76	    print(s, flush=True); LOG.write(s + "\n"); LOG.flush()
77	
78	
79	def rng_for(tf, label, null):
80	    return np.random.default_rng(int(H._sha(f"{H.SEED}|{STUDY}|{tf}|{label}|{null}"), 16) % (2 ** 32))
81	
82	
83	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the session frame
84	def session_frame(T, rows):
85	    """Rows (a split's row indices, time-ordered) as arrays plus the run structure: sessions and session x hour_bin cells are
86	    contiguous runs in row order (asserted), and the built ledger equals the cumulative prior outcomes (asserted)."""
87	    F = T.F.iloc[rows]
88	    sess = F.session_idx.to_numpy(); hb = F.hour_bin.astype(str).to_numpy()
89	    assert (np.diff(T.setup_i[rows]) > 0).all(), "rows must be time-ordered"
90	    net = T.net[rows].astype(float)
91	    pre = "l1_" if T.label == "L1" else "fnd_"
92	    stop = (F[pre + "exit_reason"].astype(str) == "stop_loss").to_numpy()
93	    today_net = F.today_net_asof.to_numpy(dtype=float); today_stops = F.today_n_stops_asof.to_numpy(dtype=int)
94	    # runs
95	    new_sess = np.r_[True, sess[1:] != sess[:-1]]
96	    sess_run = np.cumsum(new_sess) - 1
97	    new_cell = new_sess | np.r_[True, hb[1:] != hb[:-1]]
98	    cell_run = np.cumsum(new_cell) - 1
99	    assert len(set(sess.tolist())) == sess_run.max() + 1, "a session must be one contiguous run"
100	    assert len({(int(s), h) for s, h in zip(sess, hb)}) == cell_run.max() + 1, "a session x hour_bin cell must be one contiguous run"
101	    sess_first = np.flatnonzero(new_sess)
102	    tn, ts = recompute_ledger(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run)
103	    ledger_identity = dict(net_max_abs_diff=float(np.abs(tn - today_net).max()), stops_identical=bool((ts == today_stops).all()))
104	    return dict(rows=rows, sess=sess, hour_bin=hb, net=net, stop=stop, today_net=today_net, today_stops=today_stops, sess_run=sess_run,
105	                cell_run=cell_run, sess_first=sess_first, win=net > 0, ledger_identity=ledger_identity)
106	
107	
108	def recompute_ledger(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run):
109	    """The ledger before each position from a (possibly permuted) outcome sequence: cumulative sum / count within the session."""
110	    prior_net = np.cumsum(net) - net; prior_stop = np.cumsum(stop.astype(int)) - stop.astype(int)
111	    return prior_net - prior_net[sess_first][sess_run], prior_stop - prior_stop[sess_first][sess_run]
112	
113	
114	def stats7(today_net, today_stops, net):
115	    """The seven pre-registered statistics (nan when a side is empty)."""
116	    out = np.full(7, np.nan)
117	    rx, ry = sst.rankdata(today_net), sst.rankdata(net)
118	    if rx.std() > 0 and ry.std() > 0: out[0] = np.corrcoef(rx, ry)[0, 1]
119	    for j, k in enumerate(K_TESTS):
120	        m = today_stops >= k
121	        if m.any() and (~m).any(): out[1 + j] = net[m].mean() - net[~m].mean()
122	    for j, L in enumerate(L_TESTS):
123	        m = today_net <= L
124	        if m.any() and (~m).any(): out[4 + j] = net[m].mean() - net[~m].mean()
125	    return out
126	
127	
128	def holm(p):
129	    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float); m = len(p); order = np.argsort(p); adj = np.empty(m); run = 0.0
130	    for rank, i in enumerate(order):
131	        run = max(run, min(1.0, (m - rank) * p[i])); adj[i] = run
132	    return adj
133	
134	
135	def null_test(S, tf, label, null, draws=NULL_DRAWS):
136	    """Permute outcomes within cells (N1: session x hour_bin; N2: session), recompute the ledger, redo the 7 statistics."""
137	    cell = S["cell_run"] if null == "session_x_hour" else S["sess_run"]
138	    obs = stats7(S["today_net"], S["today_stops"], S["net"])
139	    rng = rng_for(tf, label, null)
140	    perm_stats = np.empty((draws, 7))
141	    for d in range(draws):
142	        perm = np.lexsort((rng.random(len(cell)), cell))                 # within each contiguous cell, a random order
143	        pn, ps = S["net"][perm], S["stop"][perm]
144	        tn, ts = recompute_ledger(pn, ps, S["sess_first"], S["sess_run"])
145	        perm_stats[d] = stats7(tn, ts, pn)
146	    valid = np.isfinite(perm_stats); n_valid = valid.sum(axis=0)
147	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
148	        lo = (1 + ((perm_stats <= obs[None, :] + 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n_valid)
149	        hi = (1 + ((perm_stats >= obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n_valid)
150	        p_abs = (1 + ((np.abs(perm_stats) >= np.abs(obs)[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n_valid)
151	    p = np.minimum(1.0, 2 * np.minimum(lo, hi))
152	    cells = np.bincount(cell)
153	    return dict(null=null, draws=draws, observed=obs, p=p, p_holm=holm(p), p_lo=lo, p_hi=hi, p_abs=p_abs, perm_mean=np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0),
154	                perm_sd=np.nanstd(perm_stats, axis=0), perm_valid=n_valid, excess=obs - np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0),
155	                n_cells=int(len(cells)), cells_size1=int((cells == 1).sum()), rows_movable=int(cells[cells > 1].sum()))
156	
157	
158	def null_table(S, results, tf, label):
159	    n = len(S["net"]); rows = []
160	    for j, t in enumerate(TESTS):
161	        if j == 0: n_a, n_b = n, None
162	        elif j <= 3: m = S["today_stops"] >= K_TESTS[j - 1]; n_a, n_b = int(m.sum()), int((~m).sum())
163	        else: m = S["today_net"] <= L_TESTS[j - 4]; n_a, n_b = int(m.sum()), int((~m).sum())
164	        r = dict(tf=tf, label=label, test=t, n_condition=n_a, n_other=n_b, observed=round(float(results[0]["observed"][j]), 4))
165	        for R in results:
166	            tag = "N1" if R["null"] == "session_x_hour" else "N2"
167	            r.update({f"{tag}_p": round(float(R["p"][j]), 4), f"{tag}_p_holm": round(float(R["p_holm"][j]), 4),
168	                      f"{tag}_perm_mean": round(float(R["perm_mean"][j]), 4), f"{tag}_perm_sd": round(float(R["perm_sd"][j]), 4),
169	                      f"{tag}_excess": round(float(R["excess"][j]), 4), f"{tag}_p_lo": round(float(R["p_lo"][j]), 4), f"{tag}_p_hi": round(float(R["p_hi"][j]), 4),
170	                      f"{tag}_p_abs_ref": round(float(R["p_abs"][j]), 4), f"{tag}_valid_draws": int(R["perm_valid"][j])})
171	        rows.append(r)
172	    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
173	
174	
175	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- descriptive tables (IS)
176	def hour_profile(S):
177	    df = pd.DataFrame(dict(hour_bin=S["hour_bin"], net=S["net"], win=S["win"], today_net=S["today_net"], today_stops=S["today_stops"], stop=S["stop"]))
178	    g = df.groupby("hour_bin")
179	    out = pd.DataFrame(dict(n=g.size(), mean_net=g.net.mean().round(2), median_net=g.net.median().round(2), win_rate=g.win.mean().round(4),
180	                            stop_rate=g.stop.mean().round(4), mean_today_net_asof=g.today_net.mean().round(2),
181	                            mean_today_n_stops_asof=g.today_stops.mean().round(3), share_stops_ge1=g.today_stops.apply(lambda x: (x >= 1).mean()).round(4),
182	                            share_net_le_m4000=g.today_net.apply(lambda x: (x <= -4000).mean()).round(4)))
183	    out = out.reindex([h for h in HOUR_ORDER if h in out.index]); out.index.name = "hour_bin"
184	    return out.reset_index()
185	
186	
187	def by_stops(S):
188	    b = np.minimum(S["today_stops"], 4); lab = np.where(b >= 4, "4+", b.astype(str))
189	    df = pd.DataFrame(dict(stops=lab, net=S["net"], win=S["win"]))
190	    g = df.groupby("stops")
191	    return pd.DataFrame(dict(n=g.size(), mean_net=g.net.mean().round(2), median_net=g.net.median().round(2), win_rate=g.win.mean().round(4))).reset_index()
192	
193	
194	def by_net_bucket(S):
195	    x = S["today_net"]
196	    lab = np.select([x > 0, x == 0, x > -2000, x > -4000, x > -6000], ["> 0", "= 0", "(-2000, 0)", "(-4000, -2000]", "(-6000, -4000]"], "<= -6000")
197	    order = ["> 0", "= 0", "(-2000, 0)", "(-4000, -2000]", "(-6000, -4000]", "<= -6000"]
198	    df = pd.DataFrame(dict(today_net_bucket=lab, net=S["net"], win=S["win"]))
199	    g = df.groupby("today_net_bucket")
200	    out = pd.DataFrame(dict(n=g.size(), mean_net=g.net.mean().round(2), median_net=g.net.median().round(2), win_rate=g.win.mean().round(4)))
201	    return out.reindex([o for o in order if o in out.index]).reset_index()
202	
203	
204	def hour_x_stops(S):
205	    df = pd.DataFrame(dict(hour_bin=S["hour_bin"], ge1=np.where(S["today_stops"] >= 1, "stops>=1", "stops=0"), net=S["net"]))
206	    g = df.groupby(["hour_bin", "ge1"]).net.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(2).unstack("ge1")
207	    g.columns = [f"{a}_{b}" for a, b in g.columns]
208	    g = g.reindex([h for h in HOUR_ORDER if h in g.index])
209	    if "mean_stops>=1" in g and "mean_stops=0" in g: g["diff_within_hour"] = (g["mean_stops>=1"] - g["mean_stops=0"]).round(2)
210	    return g.reset_index()
211	
212	
213	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- branch B: the finite-horizon replay
214	def running_min_by_session(x, sess_first, sess_run):
215	    out = np.empty_like(x)
216	    for s in range(len(sess_first)):
217	        a = sess_first[s]; b = sess_first[s + 1] if s + 1 < len(sess_first) else len(x)
218	        out[a:b] = np.minimum.accumulate(x[a:b])
219	    return out
220	
221	
222	def grid_keep(today_stops, today_net_runmin, k, L):
223	    """Absorbing rule: skip once the session's ledger at the bar has >= k stops or its running minimum net <= L."""
224	    stopped = today_stops >= k
225	    if L is not None: stopped = stopped | (today_net_runmin <= L)
226	    return ~stopped
227	
228	
229	def rearm_keep(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run, k, L):
230	    """Re-arm after a winner: while armed, take and count (stops, net since the last arm); stop when the count reaches >= k stops
231	    or <= L; while stopped, skip, and re-arm at the next SETUP (counters reset) when the skipped SETUP's paper trade wins."""
232	    n = len(net); keep = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
233	    for s in range(len(sess_first)):
234	        a = sess_first[s]; b = sess_first[s + 1] if s + 1 < len(sess_first) else n
235	        armed, ns, nn = True, 0, 0.0
236	        for j in range(a, b):
237	            if armed:
238	                keep[j] = True; ns += int(stop[j]); nn += net[j]
239	                if ns >= k or (L is not None and nn <= L): armed = False
240	            else:
241	                keep[j] = False
242	                if net[j] > 0: armed, ns, nn = True, 0, 0.0
243	    return keep
244	
245	
246	def all_cells():
247	    return [dict(max_stops_today=k, max_loss_today_inr=L, rearm_after_win=r) for r in REARM_AXIS for k in K_GRID for L in L_GRID]
248	
249	
250	def cell_masks(T):
251	    """Keep masks over T's rows for every grid cell, built from the IS rows only (the rule reads the built as-of ledger; the rearm
252	    variant reads the IS outcomes of skipped SETUPs). Rows outside IS are left True and are never scored here."""
253	    rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask); S = session_frame(T, rows)
254	    runmin = running_min_by_session(S["today_net"], S["sess_first"], S["sess_run"])
255	    masks = {}
256	    for c in all_cells():
257	        key = json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True)
258	        if not c["rearm_after_win"]: m = grid_keep(S["today_stops"], runmin, c["max_stops_today"], c["max_loss_today_inr"])
259	        else: m = rearm_keep(S["net"], S["stop"], S["sess_first"], S["sess_run"], c["max_stops_today"], c["max_loss_today_inr"])
260	        full = np.ones(T.n, dtype=bool); full[rows] = m; masks[key] = full
261	    return masks
262	
263	
264	def choose_cell(T, masks, tr):
265	    """Training-fold choice: the cell with the largest kept-vs-skipped diff among cells with kept_share >= 0.20; tie -> larger kept share."""
266	    best = None
267	    for key, m in masks.items():
268	        r = H.metrics(T, m, tr, tag="train", controls=False)
269	        if r["kept_share"] is None or r["kept_share"] < KEPT_SHARE_FLOOR or r["diff"] is None: continue
270	        cand = (r["diff"], r["kept_share"], key)
271	        if best is None or cand > best: best = cand
272	    return best
273	
274	
275	def branch_b(T, tf, out):
276	    log(f"[{tf}] branch B: the {len(all_cells())}-cell grid, nested choice, CPCV, go/no-go")

112	def tail_p(obs, dist):
113	    """Doubled-tail p of obs (vector) against dist (draws x tests), +1 corrected; also the two tails and obs's percentile."""
114	    obs = np.asarray(obs, dtype=float); dist = np.asarray(dist, dtype=float)
115	    valid = np.isfinite(dist) & np.isfinite(obs)[None, :]; n = valid.sum(axis=0)
116	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
117	        lo = (1 + ((dist <= obs[None, :] + 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
118	        hi = (1 + ((dist >= obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
119	        pct = 100.0 * (((dist < obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0) + 0.5 * ((np.abs(dist - obs[None, :]) <= 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / np.maximum(n, 1)
120	    p = np.minimum(1.0, 2 * np.minimum(lo, hi))
121	    p = np.where(np.isfinite(obs) & (n > 0), p, np.nan)
122	    return p, lo, hi, pct, n

126	def strat_diff(strata, cond, net):
127	    """OLS coefficient of net on cond with stratum fixed effects = sum_h w_h (m_a,h - m_b,h) / sum_h w_h, w_h = n_a n_b / (n_a + n_b)."""
128	    cond = np.asarray(cond, dtype=bool); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
129	    na = np.bincount(strata, weights=cond.astype(float), minlength=ns); nb = np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns) - na
130	    sa = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * cond, minlength=ns); sb = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * (~cond), minlength=ns)
131	    ok = (na > 0) & (nb > 0)
132	    if not ok.any(): return np.nan
133	    w = na[ok] * nb[ok] / (na[ok] + nb[ok])
134	    return float(np.sum(w * (sa[ok] / na[ok] - sb[ok] / nb[ok])) / w.sum())

137	def partial_spearman(strata, x, y):
138	    """Pearson correlation of the within-stratum demeaned ranks of x and y (ranks over the whole sample)."""
139	    rx, ry = sst.rankdata(x), sst.rankdata(y); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
140	    cnt = np.maximum(np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns), 1)
141	    rx = rx - (np.bincount(strata, weights=rx, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
142	    ry = ry - (np.bincount(strata, weights=ry, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
143	    if rx.std() == 0 or ry.std() == 0: return np.nan
144	    return float(np.corrcoef(rx, ry)[0, 1])

155	def holm(p):
156	    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float); m = int(np.isfinite(p).sum()); adj = np.full(len(p), np.nan)

355	    p4f, _, _, pct4f, _ = tail_p(n4_fine["observed"], simF)

360	                         N3_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_excess=round(float(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4),
361	                         N3_pct=round(float(pct3[j]), 2), N3_p=round(float(p3[j]), 4), N3_p_holm=round(float(ph3[j]), 4), N3_valid=int(n3[j]),
362	                         N4_stat=round(float(n4["observed"][j]), 4), N4_boot_sd=round(float(n4["boot_sd"][j]), 4), N4_ci90_lo=round(float(n4["ci90"][0][j]), 4), N4_ci90_hi=round(float(n4["ci90"][1][j]), 4),

364	                         N4_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_pct=round(float(pct4s[j]), 2), N4_sim_p=round(float(p4s[j]), 4),

368	                                    rejected_N4=bool(np.nanmin(n4["p_holm"]) < CFG["alpha"]), min_p_holm_N4fine=float(np.nanmin(n4_fine["p_holm"])),
369	                                    signs_agree=bool(all(np.sign(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])) == np.sign(n4["observed"][j]) for j in range(7)

content.subject: Install the program's Python packages (shap, hmmlearn, mapie, arch, torch, psutil) and verify imports
content.description: numpy pandas pyarrow scipy scikit-learn xgboost shap numba matplotlib joblib torch statsmodels hmmlearn mapie ruptures arch stumpy; verify every import; note versions (pandas 3.x vs local 2.3.3) in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md

content.subject: Rebuild both datasets (1m, 5m) from fz_v3/data via engine.load; cross-check against fz_v3/built; write QUALITY.md
content.description: One build script per timeframe under fz_v3/out/build/: engine.run (ST1 rules on 1m, ST2 on 5m), Foundation trades priced (lot 65, 5 pts slip, ZERODHA_NFO_FUT), fz.run with ST7/ST8 blocks, per-SETUP feature table with the same column contract as built/, plus the L1 intraday 15:25 label, the truncation causality check. Compare SETUP counts, trades, room card against fz_v3/built; the cloud rebuild wins; log discrepancies in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Validation harness: splitter (12 IS blocks, purge by label exit, 3-session embargo), CPCV paths, append-only ledger via score(), PBO, DSR, block bootstrap, SPA
content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator. Every gate candidate goes through score(); kept-vs-skipped expectancy, session-matched random control (fz_report.random_control), permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p), CPCV 11 paths, go/no-go rule (PBO <= 0.2, CPCV p5 diff > 0, DSR p < 0.1, kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300/80, top-1%-removed value > 0, slippage 8 pts survival). Break tests (BDE CUSUM, Chow) as pre-registration.

content.subject: Feature vocabulary pass: clustered MDA/MDI/SFI, FFD, BSADF/CUSUM, BOCPD run length, novelty scalars, SHAP interactions; freeze <= 8 clusters
content.description: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance merged with the feature contributions of regime-breaks, regime-states (BOCPD, GMM), motif (nn_dist_prefix, p1_dist_prefix), rocket window summaries. Per-year stability filter. Shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search.

content.subject: H1-H5 classical studies through the harness (gate audit, regime, volume, levels, learned gate) on IS
content.description: H1 what ST7/ST8 skip (precision/recall as loser filter, big winners); H2 regime grid; H3 visibly-high-volume reaction; H4 level respect vs break; H5 depth-3 tree + greedy rule list + GBM ceiling. All IS, via score(), every trial in the ledger.

content.subject: Learned-gate family: meta-labelling + full-information policy tree, distilled to rule list / scorecard; regime states; LLM hypotheses (round 0 blind, round 1 cross-fitted); FQI exit; session stop; conformal operating point; sizing
content.description: DESIGN_PANEL merged program: meta-label gate (L1 label, winsorised |net| weights, HGB/bagging ceilings, scorecard, rule list), policy trees, GMM/HMM/BOCPD regime states, LLM-hypothesis rounds with family-wise max-T permutation, FQI exit policy (learner C grid, B hindsight imitation, A FQI), session stop rule with within-session x hour null, conformal skip operating point, sizing conditional on a surviving gate, null tapes (5m), adversarial drift.
content.activeForm: Running the learned-gate family and modern-ML studies

content.subject: Walk-forward learn-after-each-trade policy with the trade journal (IS learning curve, continued through OOS); compose with rl.py for exit/size
content.description: fz_learn.py prototype: journal rows per SETUP (features, decision, reason, model state id, fill, exit, MFE/MAE, pts, gross, costs, net, R, running equity/DD/PF); online learners (LinUCB/Thompson on logistic or tree-embedded model, online GBM refits, k-trade cadence); fractional Kelly sizing with max lots and daily loss stop; learning curve vs take-all and random control; deterministic replay.

content.subject: OOS opened once by one script for at most three frozen candidates (rule list, learner, ST7/ST8 comparator)
content.description: fz_v3/out/oos_once.py reads frozen candidate JSON + sha; scores OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 with random control, permutation p, kept-vs-skipped, winner recall; the learner continues updating through OOS as it would live. Caveats: OOS window = published lab window, used by ST9-12 exit grid.

content.subject: Report survivors and plan to the user before creating strategy files; then code ST13/ST14 (fz_learn.py, strategy_13/14.json, tests, docs, S49, REPORT.md)
content.description: Tell the user the plan and survivors first. Then: fz_learn.py beside fz.py (entry_rule fz_v3), strategy_13.json / strategy_14.json with every threshold / weight / hyper-parameter as a sourced key, journal as an output table, deterministic replay, engine.py untouched, ST5-ST8 bit-for-bit unchanged; extend tests/test_fz_parity.py and tests/test_truncation.py; FZ.md, README.md, S49 (Rule 0), fz_v3/out/REPORT.md, QUALITY.md.

    p=np.asarray(p,float); m=len(p); o=np.argsort(p); adj=np.empty(m); run=0.0
    for rank,i in enumerate(o):
        run=max(run,min(1.0,(m-rank)*p[i])); adj[i]=run
    return adj

        print("   N1 excess", t.N1_excess.round(1).tolist(), "N1_p_abs_ref", t.N1_p_abs_ref.tolist(), "-> holm(abs_ref)", np.round(holm(t.N1_p_abs_ref),4).tolist())
        print("   N1_p_lo", t.N1_p_lo.tolist(), "N1_p_hi", t.N1_p_hi.tolist())

print("\n=== repair N3/N4 (5minute L1) ===")
